background_setting: A rural two-lane asphalt road under bright clear daytime skies. The road stretches ahead with a faded center line, flanked by dry grassy shoulders, occasional roadside trees and utility poles. Distant low hills and a bright blue sky with a few scattered clouds fill the horizon. Consistent hard shadows from vehicles and roadside objects fall across the tarmac, indicating a high sun.

lighting.shadows: Consistent, sharply defined shadows cast beneath and slightly ahead of the truck and along the roadside
lighting.illumination_effect: Crisp, high-contrast illumination with glinting reflections off the aluminium ladder and metallic vehicle surfaces

aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant grey asphalt, white truck body, silvery aluminium, blue sky, muted green and tan roadside vegetation, with a pop of red from the warning flag and tail lights
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Ordinary daytime drive, latent unseen danger, quiet tension
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating ladder rungs and road center-line dashes

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam motion following the truck along the road; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame

context: Autonomous driving scenario illustrating a perception failure where the ego vehicle detects only the truck body and misjudges an overhanging ladder hazard

The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The gap between the ego vehicle and the truck begins to narrow as the ego vehicle maintains its cruising speed without slowing. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle continues closing in, the ladder and its red flag looming larger at windshield height as the vehicle drives underneath the overhang without decelerating. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam ego view shows a white pickup truck ahead in the same lane on a bright, clear two-lane road, an aluminium ladder extending well past its open tailgate at windshield height with a small red flag tied to the end. From 0:02 to 0:03 the gap begins to close as the ego vehicle does not slow, the ladder appearing nearer.
